summary: Discover Fractal web app stories in the kit Storybook by glob

replay.detail: Graph admission and action replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: Database, projections and wire contracts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Development tooling only. The kit Storybook now indexes every apps/fractal-web/src story file, so adding an app story no longer edits the kit Storybook configuration. Storybook resolves the app's virtual:build-identity module to a fixed synthetic identity. The developer bar trigger's accessible name now starts with its visible wf text.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration is needed.
